retrieved.title: Permissions incorrect on \\fs02\shared
retrieved.description: [TCK-60127] Ticket raised because several Delhi Sales users report they can see the folder \\fs02\shared but get 'access denied' when opening files inside it. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: Corrected the inherited NTFS permissions on \\fs02\shared for the relevant Delhi Sales group and re-propagated ACLs so the files opened as expected.
